status.title: CPU runs fail with explicit --devices due to list parsing and fixed DDP strategy in CLI

selection: Selected adaptively for a clear maintainer decision and a lightweight executable acceptance after earlier cohort outcomes; it is not in the original cohort execution order. Arm order is the original randomized assignment.
agent: Codex CLI gpt-6.1-sol, low reasoning, separate ephemeral process per session
arms: Both arms receive the same pinned source, issue archive, public checks, editable workspace, bounded tools and their own previous-session output. Treatment additionally has the standard Memex manual and a new empty L3 store. This restricted baseline is not every default Codex feature.
sessions: S1 investigates the earlier issue and source without editing or testing.
S2 receives the later maintainer decision and its own S1 handoff; implements the agreed CPU-device behavior and can run public tests.
S3 is a fresh process reviewing the result and can run public checks. Final public and withheld checks run on each candidate. No task prompt commands a memory call.
frozenAcceptance: For CPU, a single positive --devices integer is a process count; reject zero, negatives and multiple IDs with a useful error.
Preserve auto and GPU device behavior, and distinguish the already-changed DDP strategy from the remaining devices issue.
Specify positive and invalid CPU regression cases.
publicChecks: CPU one device becomes integer process count
withheldChecks: CPU zero and negative rejected with --devices in error
GPU single ID and auto preserved
environment: Execute the actual pinned Python fit() and CLI parser in a network-disabled VM sandbox; replace PyTorch, Lightning, datastore and logging with test doubles, and capture Trainer arguments before training. This is a functional interface test, not an actual model-training run or full upstream suite.
review: Two AI reviewers evaluate anonymized candidate diffs, public/withheld test output and handoffs; adjudicate material disagreement. Preserve failures and original reviews.
cost: Record per-session Codex token usage, elapsed time, gateway-review usage and matching visible wallet rows. Subscription allocation, interrupted turns and non-model costs remain UNKNOWN unless verified.
limitations: Real public issue with earlier proposed solutions and a current maintainer decision; possible training or history leakage.
Historical issue discussion replayed against a current pinned source, not a live production session.
Mocked ML dependencies and investigator-written verifier are not a real Lightning training run or maintainer acceptance.
Preliminary test-fixture and file-copy setup failures were corrected before this registration and retained privately.
AI reviewers are not human reviewers; the constrained baseline is not a full default Codex comparison.
